services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Teachers can plan a trip to the Staten Island Children’s Museum. Students learn through their hands-on experience, generated by their own curiosity and excitement! All programs are guided by a museum educator; connect with science, language arts, social studies, the arts and early childhood education; address New York City Scope and Sequence, Blueprint for Teaching and Learning in the Arts and Common Core Standards. Our 90-minute workshops are designed to engage students in hands-on, educational art experiences. These programs are offered Tuesday through Friday at either 10:30 AM or 1:00 PM. A minimum of 20 students (12 for Special Education) is required to host a workshop in the classroom
